author: Danika Young
title: Baptist Hill High School mourning football player, 15, killed in Hollywood house fire - NewsBreak
text:
By Danika Young Evan Geiger ,
7 hours ago
HOLLYWOOD, S.C. (WCBD) - Baptist Hill High School is mourning the loss of one of their own, Jaiden Odom, 15, of Charleston.
Odom died during a house fire on Tuesday morning at 12:30 a.m. on Erika Place in Hollywood.
"Jaiden will forever be a part of Baptist Hill, and his memory will live on in the halls, on the field, and in the hearts of his classmates, teammates, teachers, coaches, and the entire Bobcat community," Baptist Hill High School said.
Odom was an offensive lineman and wore the number 57 for the Bobcats.
"Our hearts, prayers, and deepest condolences are with Jaiden’s family and loved ones during this unimaginable time. May they feel the love and support of the entire Baptist Hill community surrounding them," Baptist Hill High School said.
1 dead following Hollywood structure fire The St. Paul Fire Department is investigating the fire with the South Carolina State Fire Marshal, according to the coroner's office
